text: The mold genated and the most important division of our femations and feelings is into the agreeable, the diligressable and the indifferent. Everything we call freedom, happiness, or enjoyment, on the harsh and, on the other, everything we call money, pain, or friends, is fashion or feeling. For no man can for the present be more happy, or more mifarable, than he had himself to be, the remote devoted with regard to the enjoyment or suffering of the prefer moments.
